create_TritonKDAKernel: create a TritonKDAKernel instance to run Triton-based KDA linear attention decode and extend
run_decode_method: run the decode method with q, k, v, a, b tensors, A_log, dt_bias, ssm_states, cache_indices, and query_start_loc
run_extend_method: run the extend method with q, k, v, g, beta tensors, ssm_states, cache_indices, and query_start_loc
build_kda_fused_update: build a fused KDA update using fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update with QK L2 normalization and softplus gating
review_TritonKDAKernel: review the TritonKDAKernel class that extends LinearAttnKernelBase for CPU-skipped Triton KDA kernels
